title: FairMed-XGB: A Bayesian-Optimised Multi-Metric Framework with Explainability for Demographic Equity in Critical Healthcare Data
abstract: arXiv:2603.14947v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background:Machine learning models in emergency medicine often exhibit demographic biases, particularly gender disparities, which can compromise fairness, clinical trust, and decision-making reliability. Existing mitigation approaches typically optimise isolated fairness metrics, failing to address the multi-dimensional nature of bias while maintaining predictive performance and interpretability. Methods: We propose FairMed-XGB, a Bayesian-optimised, multi-metric fairness framework integrated into an XGBoost classifier. The model incorporates a composite fairness-aware loss function combining Statistical Parity Difference, Theil Index, and Wasserstein Distance. Bayesian optimisation is used to balance fairness and predictive accuracy. The framework is evaluated on seven cohorts derived from the MIMIC-IV-ED and eICU datasets. SHAP-based explainability is employed to analyse feature contributions and identify bias-related pattern

translated_title: FairMed-XGB：一个基于贝叶斯优化的多指标可解释性框架，用于危重医疗数据中的人口统计公平性
translated_abstract: 背景：急诊医学中的机器学习模型常常表现出人口统计学偏差，特别是性别差异，这可能损害公平性、临床信任和决策可靠性。现有的缓解方法通常只优化孤立的公平性指标，无法在保持预测性能和可解释性的同时解决偏差的多维性质。方法：我们提出FairMed-XGB，一个集成到XGBoost分类器中的贝叶斯优化的多指标公平性框架。该模型引入了一个综合的公平性感知损失函数，结合了统计均等差异、泰尔指数和Wasserstein距离。贝叶斯优化被用来平衡公平性和预测准确性。该框架在源自MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU数据集的七个队列上进行评估。采用基于SHAP的可解释性方法来分析特征贡献并识别与偏差相关的模式。
tldr: 该论文提出FairMed-XGB框架，通过贝叶斯优化将统计均等差异、泰尔指数和Wasserstein距离三种公平性指标整合为综合损失函数并融入XGBoost分类器，在保持预测性能的同时，利用SHAP可解释性分析有效减轻了急诊医疗机器学习模型中的性别等人口统计学偏差。
